name: Agenda

drm.evidence: a first-party page the host serves from its own Assets/tiles - no media element, no EME call, no network request of any kind; the WebView2 surface it runs in is the one surveyed in docs/reports/win-host-m1.md

4:3·M.label: The week
4:3·M.notes: Kitchen Command's calendar role: the page lays itself out for this class, so no region is cut - the whole page IS the facet

1:1·M.label: The week
1:1·M.notes: Family Hub's calendar role: the page reflows to a square and shows fewer days

3:4.label: Today only
3:4.notes: a tall slot shows today rather than squeezing seven days

notes: Prism's own week, served locally at https://tiles.prism/agenda/ from the host's Assets/tiles. No account, no sign-in, no network: the week is a document core owns (tiles:agenda), editable from the panel and from a phone through the §6 remote API. Personal calendars still connect through Merge (charter §2.1) - this is the first-party page for a week the box already holds.
